column15: english
Clean liftoff! Everyone down here is cheering.
Tower cleared. Have a good trip.
We're going! We're really going!
Good thrust. This pushes a lot.

column14: Control, el cohete va hacia arriba. Como debe.
column15: Control, the rocket is going up. As it should.

column14: Confirmado. Esa es la dirección buena.
column15: Confirmed. That's the right direction.
Control, what a noise!

column14: Es el sonido del dinero. Seguid.
column15: That's the sound of money. Carry on.
All nominal. Enjoy the ride.
Climbing. All green.
Good trajectory. Keep it up.

column14: Altitud subiendo bien. Ni un susto.
column15: Altitude rising nicely. Not a single scare.
Clean ascent. The engineers are smiling.

column14: El cielo se pone oscuro. Qué bonito.
column15: The sky is getting dark. How pretty.

column14: Control, ya casi no hay aire fuera.
column15: Control, there's almost no air outside now.
Correct. Don't open the window.
Pitching over as planned.
We see it. Perfect.
Control, are we good on speed?
Very good. Don't overdo it.

column14: Esto es como subir en un ascensor muy grande.
column15: It's like riding a very big elevator.

column14: Seguid el perfil. Lo estáis bordando.
column15: Follow the profile. You're nailing it.
All stable. My stomach, less so.
Welcome back to the air.
Good angle. Hold it.
We're starting to feel the air.
Control, it's starting to glow here.
Normal. Shield forward.
Control, how are we doing?
Very well. You're coming home.

column14: Volvemos a casa. Con algo de calor.
column15: Heading home. With a bit of heat.
Entry trajectory looks right.
The shield is working. So are we.

column14: Ya estáis abajo del todo. Casi.
column15: You're almost all the way down. Almost.
Speed coming down. Very good.

column14: Control, ya veo el suelo. Qué bonito es.
column15: Control, I can see the ground. It's so pretty.
You'll be standing on it soon. Easy.

column14: Todo listo para bajar. Manos quietas.
column15: All set for the way down. Hands still.

column14: Bajando suave. Como una pluma gorda.
column15: Coming down softly. Like a fat feather.
Control, is anyone waiting down there?

column14: Todo el centro espacial. Con tarta.
column15: The whole space center. With cake.
Stable descent. Almost home.
Altitude dropping. Nerves rising.

column14: Lo hacéis muy bien. Ya queda poco.
column15: You're doing very well. Not long now.
